sqlReaderQuery.value:
select a.*,b.Requirement_Name as Mandatory from ql_Person_Qualification a,
 (Select pers.Id_Number,
					rqc.ql_Qualification_Id
					,rqp.Requirement_Name
 
 
	From Person pers
	Left Join Posting posti on pers.Id_Number=posti.Id_Number
        Left Join Grade g on g.Grade_sht_Title=pers.Grade_sht_Title 
	Left Join Post on posti.Post_Id=Post.Post_Id
 
	
	join Role on g.Spare_Char_1_255 =Role.Role_id
	Join  ql_Requirement_Structure rqp on rqp.Parent_Key=Role.Role_id
	Left Join ql_Requirement_Structure rqc on rqp.ql_req_struct_Id = rqc.Parent_ql_struct_Id
	where rqp.Parent_Key IS NOT NULL
	And Role.Role_Name NOT LIKE '%!Closed%'
	And pers.Date_Leaving>Getdate()
	
	And (posti.Posting_sDate=(Select max(posti2.Posting_sDate) from Posting posti2 where posti.Id_Number=posti2.Id_number and posti2.Posting_sDate<=GetDate()) OR posti.Posting_sDate IS NULL)
	) b 
	

where a.Id_Number=b.Id_Number
and a.ql_Qualification_Id=b.ql_Qualification_Id
and a.Date_Last_mod > '@{activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.start_date}'
